home.lede: Three resorts on one stretch of Red Sea coast, with a house reef close enough to reach before breakfast.
home.manifesto1: Marsa Alam has the clearest water on the Egyptian coast and almost none of the crowd that finds it. Our three resorts sit on the same stretch of it — walking distance apart, sharing one reef, one dive centre, and one reservations desk.
home.manifesto2: Which means you book once, and move between them freely: dinner at one, a dive from another, the quiet pool at the third.
home.reefTitle: Forty metres of sand, then coral
home.reefBody: No boat, no transfer, no waiting for a group. The reef begins where the beach ends — turtles in the seagrass before eight, and the drop-off close enough to swim to from the jetty.
home.experiencesTitle: What the coast is actually for
home.offersTitle: Rates you will not find anywhere else
home.weddingsTitle: One brief. Three resorts. One answer.
home.weddingsBody: Send a single request and every resort that fits comes back to you — capacities, rates, and dates in one reply, instead of three conversations that contradict each other.

footer.blurb: Three resorts on one stretch of Red Sea coast. Reservations answered by people, 8am to midnight.
footer.rights: Fantazia Hotels & Resorts · Marsa Alam, Red Sea
